text: Oh, absolutely. Why bother with the tedious, archaic practice of brushing your teeth with a bristled stick and fluoride paste when you can just aggressively shake a piece of molded plastic? It’s the ultimate life hack, really. While the rest of us are wasting time flossing and visiting dentists, you’re out there achieving a "Greek statue" physique by simply vibrating your arm for ten minutes. It’s not just fitness; it’s a revolution against the very concept of effort. Who needs a healthy smile when you can have the illusion of muscle definition through sheer, unadulterated laziness? Truly, the future of health is here, and it involves holding a lightweight object while pretending you’re working hard.
